statement: A byte string writing 4294967295 -- a value that fits in 4 bytes -- with additional-info 27 (an 8-byte argument) is not decoded
deviation: 4294967295 (2^32-1)'s shortest form is the ai=26 form `1a ff ff ff ff`. The ai=27 form is 4 bytes longer. The scanner's judgement is `v > u32::MAX`, with 2^32-1 / 2^32 on either side of it.
origin: gx self-authored for the fix hand (req/38 §16 H6-4)

control.note: 2^32 is the smallest value that does not fit in 4 bytes, so the ai=27 form is shortest = accepted
